title: Listening for biodiversity — AviSonar makes ecosystem health a measurable ESG proxy
subtitle: Carbon disclosure has audit-grade discipline. Biodiversity is the harder half. AviSonar listens — and delivers measured, longitudinal, site-level evidence with the traceability auditors expect of any ESG figure.
featuredImageAlt: AviSonar — passive acoustic monitoring as ESG-grade biodiversity evidence
excerpt: ESG, CSRD, CSDDD and TNFD frameworks increasingly ask for evidence — not narrative — that operations and supply chains don't degrade the ecosystems they sit in. Bird species richness is one of ecology's most established ecosystem-health proxies. AviSonar listens for them, continuously, locally, and turns the recordings into audit-grade data.
